name: d1b-iron-outpost-hard
note: Like d1-iron-outpost, but nothing is ready: no electric drills in stock (craft them: circuits, gears, plates are in chests) and no power at the stop (bring it ~260 tiles from the base grid, or build local power).
setup_lua:
-- d1b-iron-outpost-hard setup (stage S3): like d1 but no power at the stop and no electric drills in stock.
-- (d1 text follows): an untouched iron patch ~300 tiles SW of the base, a short east-west rail line
-- 35 tiles north of it with a train stop, a parked train (locomotive + cargo wagon), and power at the stop (a hidden
-- electric-energy-interface standing in for the outpost's grid connection). Returns the positions the goal uses.
local s, f = game.surfaces.nauvis, game.forces.player
local ore = s.find_entities_filtered{name="iron-ore", position={-225,170}, radius=40}
local x1,y1,x2,y2 = 1e9,1e9,-1e9,-1e9
for _,r in pairs(ore) do local p=r.position x1=math.min(x1,p.x) y1=math.min(y1,p.y) x2=math.max(x2,p.x) y2=math.max(y2,p.y) end
local px, py = math.floor((x1+x2)/2), math.floor((y1+y2)/2)
for _, e in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{area={{-262,114},{-188,132}}, type={"tree","simple-entity"}}) do e.destroy() end
for x = -255, -195, 2 do
  s.create_entity{name="straight-rail", position={x,122}, direction=defines.direction.east, force=f}
end
local ry = s.find_entities_filtered{name="straight-rail", position={-225,122}, radius=4}[1].position.y
local stop = s.create_entity{name="train-stop", position={-223, ry + 2}, direction=defines.direction.east, force=f}
stop.backer_name = "Iron Outpost"
local loco = s.create_entity{name="locomotive", position={-227, ry}, direction=defines.direction.east, force=f}
local wagon = s.create_entity{name="cargo-wagon", position={-234, ry}, direction=defines.direction.east, force=f}
local pole = nil
local removed = 0
for _, c in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{type={"container","logistic-container"}, force=f}) do
  local n = c.get_item_count("electric-mining-drill")
  if n > 0 then removed = removed + c.remove_item{name="electric-mining-drill", count=n} end
end
storage.bench_outpost = {patch={x1,y1,x2,y2}, stop={stop.position.x, stop.position.y}, wagon=wagon.unit_number}
return {px=px, py=py, sx=math.floor(stop.position.x), sy=math.floor(stop.position.y),
  wx=math.floor(wagon.position.x), wy=math.floor(wagon.position.y), stop_rail=stop.connected_rail ~= nil,
  loco=loco ~= nil, wagon_ok=wagon ~= nil, drills_removed=removed}

objectives.name: iron-outpost
objectives.goal: @{agent} add the iron patch I'm standing on [gps={px},{py}] to our system: electric mining drills on it, and the ore on a belt to the train stop at [gps={sx},{sy}], ending right by the track (load the parked wagon at [gps={wx},{wy}] if you can). There's no power out there yet, and we're out of electric drills. Belts, not bots.

score.name: drills_on_patch
score.lua: local p=storage.bench_outpost.patch local a={{p[1]-2,p[2]-2},{p[3]+2,p[4]+2}} return s.count_entities_filtered{name="electric-mining-drill", area=a}

score.name: ore_at_stop
score.lua:
local o=storage.bench_outpost local n=0
for _,b in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{type={"transport-belt","underground-belt","splitter"}, position=o.stop, radius=16}) do
  for i=1,b.get_max_transport_line_index() do n=n+b.get_transport_line(i).get_item_count("iron-ore") end end
local w=s.find_entities_filtered{name="cargo-wagon", position=o.stop, radius=20}[1]
if w then n=n+w.get_item_count("iron-ore") end
return n
score.note: iron ore on belts within 16 tiles of the stop plus in the wagon

score.name: drills_working
score.lua: local p=storage.bench_outpost.patch local a={{p[1]-2,p[2]-2},{p[3]+2,p[4]+2}} local k=0 for _,d in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{name="electric-mining-drill", area=a}) do if d.status==defines.entity_status.working then k=k+1 end end return k

score.name: wagon_ore
score.lua: local w=s.find_entities_filtered{name="cargo-wagon", position=storage.bench_outpost.stop, radius=20}[1] return w and w.get_item_count("iron-ore") or 0

objectives.selftest_lua:
local o=storage.bench_outpost local p=o.patch local k=0
for x=p[1]+2,p[3]-2,4 do for y=p[2]+2,p[4]-2,4 do if k<8 then
  if s.create_entity{name="electric-mining-drill", position={x+0.5,y+0.5}, direction=defines.direction.north, force=f} then k=k+1 end end end end
local b=s.create_entity{name="transport-belt", position={o.stop[1]-4.5, o.stop[2]+3.5}, direction=defines.direction.east, force=f}
b.get_transport_line(1).insert_at_back({name="iron-ore", count=1}) b.get_transport_line(2).insert_at_back({name="iron-ore", count=1})
local w=s.find_entities_filtered{name="cargo-wagon", position=o.stop, radius=20}[1] w.insert({name="iron-ore", count=50})
return k
